title: TAPMM: A Traffic-Aware Page Mapping Method for Multi-level NUMA Systems
problem: Memory page placement significantly influences application performance in NUMA systems, with access bottlenecks occurring between high-level NUMA domains consisting of multiple chiplets in modern architectures.
motivation: With chiplet-based architectures becoming increasingly complex, optimizing memory page mapping is critical for achieving efficient bandwidth utilization in multi-level NUMA systems.
method: TAPMM conceptualizes multi-level NUMA systems as a memory access tree and leverages hardware performance events to monitor real-time system traffic patterns. Based on traffic awareness, the method identifies and applies optimal page mapping strategies to improve bandwidth efficiency.
key_novelty: Traffic-aware page mapping approach using hardware performance events to model multi-level NUMA systems as a memory access tree for bandwidth-efficient optimization.
contributions: Identifies memory access bottlenecks in multi-level NUMA domains consisting of chiplets
Proposes TAPMM: a traffic-aware page mapping method for multi-level NUMA systems
Demonstrates up to 2.12× speedup on commodity hardware compared to existing tools
